api.notes: `single` or `range`; anything else warns and reads as `single`.

A date `YYYY-MM-DD` in single mode, `{start, end}` in range mode as a property or the attribute `2026-03-01/2026-03-07` (an ISO 8601 interval). Uncontrolled: the element holds its own selection; setting `value` never fires an event.
The `value` attribute is the initial selection; there is no separate default (D-006).
A pick fires the cancelable `tct-value-change` (the new value in `detail`), then native `input` and `change`, composed. In range mode the first click of a range fires nothing.
Earliest selectable date; unreadable values are ignored.
`readonly ((date: Date) => boolean)[]`; a day is unavailable when any returns `false`.
Days a range may span, both endpoints counted; later days are disabled once the start is picked.
Fewest days a range may span; the start itself stays selectable.
The visible month (and the day that is the tab stop): `YYYY-MM-DD`. Follows the page the user turns to.
Cancelable intent event before the user moves the visible month (arrows off the grid, PageUp/PageDown, the buttons); `detail.focusDate` and `detail.reason`.
`navigateTo(date)` shows the month of `date` and makes it the tab stop, without an event; `focus()` focuses the tab stop.
Inverted: days of the neighbouring months show by default, `no-outside-days` hides them (a boolean attribute cannot default to true).
Months take as many week rows as they need instead of six.

hooks.notes: Pure function in `@tecton-wc/components/calendar/utils.js`: the weeks of a month as `CalendarDay` records. Not a controller: it holds no state.
Pure factory in the utils subpath: `isDateDisabled`, the min/max window and the range-span rules from an anchor.
Owns the visible month, the focus date and the pending focus after a page turn; asks the element to dispatch `tct-focus-date-change` before it moves.
`@tecton-wc/core/controllers/grid-focus.js`: arrow, Home/End and page navigation over a grid with a roving tab stop; RTL-aware; never handles a key the browser needs (Alt, IME, defaultPrevented).

hooks.upstream: utils subpath (isSameDay, isDateInRange, getWeekNumber, parseISO, dateToISO)
hooks.notes: Re-exported from `@tecton-wc/core/date/plain-date.js` with the calendar helpers, so the upstream utils import path has one home here.

keyboard.action: Moves one day (mirrored in right-to-left); at the edge of the visible months the page turns.
Moves one week; the page turns at the edge.
First / last day of the week (APG date grid).
Same day of the previous / next month, clamped to the shorter month; with Shift the previous / next year.
Picks the day; in range mode the first pick is the start and the second the end.
Cancels a range pick in progress; otherwise left alone so a picker around the calendar can close.
One tab stop per month grid (the selected day, else today, else the first available day); the previous/next buttons are tab stops before the grids.

form.notes: Not form-associated: it is a picker surface. `tct-date-input`, `tct-date-range-input` and `tct-date-time-input` own the form value and render it.

differences.text: Uncontrolled (D-006): the element holds its own selection with `value` (a date, or a range) and native `input`/`change` events after the cancelable `tct-value-change`; upstream is controlled with `value`/`defaultValue` and `onChange`. A range value is `{start, end}` as a property and an ISO 8601 interval `start/end` as an attribute.

The intent event `tct-focus-date-change` (cancelable, before the month moves) replaces `onFocusDateChange`, and `navigateTo()`/`focus()` on the element replace `handleRef`. `hasOutsideDays` is the inverted `no-outside-days`.

PageUp/PageDown follow the APG date grid (a month, with Shift a year, on the same day clamped to the month), Home/End the week, and a page turn is announced through the shared announcer. Range progress ("Select end date") and the selected range are announced politely.
The week-number cell is the ISO week of the first day of the row that belongs to the month (the row of 2026-01-04 is week 1), computed from indices, never from a `Date` anchor.

A disabled month button stays focusable (`aria-disabled`, tooltip) so keyboard users find out why; unavailable days are `aria-disabled` buttons with the disabled text role, not a second layer of opacity.

Tecton day cells: selected endpoints use the primary action fill and its own text roles, hover and focus the tertiary state roles, the range band the muted accent wash, today a ring; nothing relies on a colour literal.

core.calendar.notes: Guides: [mwg:spatial-navigation] the date grid keys and the browser-owned keys; [mwg:support-global-calendar-systems] Gregorian display with the locale's names and digits, `Intl` only; [mwg:capture-location-agnostic-data] the value is a calendar date, never an instant; [mwg:coordinate-global-events] no zone in a date. Dates come from `@tecton-wc/core/date`, the only module that imports `@internationalized/date`.
